description.value: All Mex'd Up is a taco-focused Mexican takeout shop in Port Alberni's Alberni Valley, serving freshly made tacos — beef, chicken, pork, and vegetarian — alongside homemade salsas and fresh toppings. The kitchen emphasizes locally-sourced, made-from-scratch preparation with a modern twist on authentic Mexican flavours. Craft beers and cocktails are also available, making it a lively stop for cyclists coming through central Vancouver Island.
